newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Thursday, with prices are expected to stabilize ahead of Friday's July options expiry, traders said.

The benchmark July contract should continue to ease ahead of its expiry on June 30, however. Recent speculative liquidation has pressured July below light support levels, but further losses are anticipated as open interest remains high with 12 trading days until expiry.
As of early Tuesday, open interest stood at 75,212 lots in July, CSCE said.
Firm support was pegged at 11.20 cents a lb for July sugar, and then at 11.00 cents.
Wednesday, July closed 0.11 cent lower at 11.26 cents after trading from 11.37 to 11.22 cents. October eased 0.10 cent to 11.15 cents, while the outer months ended 0.06 and 0.05 cent weaker.
An estimated 24,817 lots changed hands on the day.

LIFFE white sugar futures were slightly higher on Thursday in thin, midday dealings. At 0852 EDT/1352, spot August stood $0.20 firmer at $320.50, while the back months were trading $0.50 higher to $0.50 lower.
